description: Serves the visitor who has waited longest. Ignores groups and priorities.
enforcement_notes: Does not consider fairness constraints; they are only evaluated after the run.

description: Serves the lowest priority-class number first (1 = highest), ties by arrival time. Can starve low classes.
enforcement_notes: Does not consider fairness constraints; they are only evaluated after the run.

description: Effective priority = class - rate x wait, so long-waiting lower-priority visitors eventually overtake.

aging_rate_per_minute.description: Class levels gained per minute waited.

enforcement_notes: Reduces starvation by construction of the priority formula; no fairness constraint is enforced.

description: Score = alpha x wait/T_ref + beta x priority + gamma x group-wait pressure, with an overdue guard. An online heuristic that tries to reduce group wait disparities and very long waits.

w_guard_minutes.description: Overdue guard; defaults from the max-individual-wait limit.

d_scale_minutes.description: Disparity scale; defaults from the mean-wait disparity limit.

n_pressure_min.description: Observations per group before pressure is used.

enforcement_notes: Attempts to reduce mean-wait disparity and long individual waits online. Provable property: bounded overtaking. No aggregate fairness constraint is guaranteed; status is evaluated after the run. Weights are engineering assumptions.
